label: Comparing the two cofactors
subgoals: Compute both cofactors in the variable
Test whether the negative cofactor implies the positive one

label: Classifying every variable
subgoals: Run the cofactor comparison for each variable
Label each variable positive unate, negative unate or binate

label: Syntactic versus semantic unateness
subgoals: Note that a cover with one polarity per variable is unate
Note that a binate-looking cover may still be a unate function
Decide from the cofactors, not from the expression
